FULL TEXT:
Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, Gorakhpur
Admission Cell
Detailed Notice for Second Physical Spot Counselling of B.Tech. First Year
IMPORTANT DATES
Registration Friday, August 01, 2025/ 10:00AM to Wednesday,
August 13, 2025/10:00 AM
Display of Vacant Seat for Spot Round-2 Tuesday, August 12, 2025/03:00 PM.
Physical Reporting for Spot Round-2 at
MMMUT-Gorakhpur
Wednesday, August 13, 2025/10:00 AM
Registration link https://mmmut.admissions.nic.in/
Participation Eligibility (Who can apply?)
1. Candidates registered by paying Rs. 2500/- for online counselling conducted by
Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, Gorakhpur but failed to get a
seat. (Such candidates need to register themselves again on registration portal
for spot counselling between 01 August 2025 (10:00 am) to 13 August 2025
(11:00 am), but they don’t need to pay Rs. 2500/- as registration fee again.)
2. JEE MAIN qualified candidates who have not registered in online counselling
conducted by MMMUT, Gorakhpur. (Home State-Those candidates who have qualified
JEE MAIN with UP state eligibility, Other State- Those candidates who have qualified JEE MAIN
with state eligibility code other than Uttar Pradesh) (Such candidates need to pay Rs. 2500/-
as registration fee in online mode from registration portal between 01 August
2025 (10 am) to 13 August 2025 (11:00 am)
Seat Allotment
1. Information regarding tentative seat matrix of vacant seats in various programs
will be published at University Website (www.mmmut.ac.in) on Tuesday,
August 12, 2025/03:00 PM. The vacant seats shall be allotted as per CRL rank
of the candidates present at MMMUT for spot counselling. No category/sub-
category benefit shall be given in spot round seat allotment.
Process for Participation:
All candidates successfully registered on counselling portal should report personally
at Multi-Purpose Hall, Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology,
Gorakhpur on August 13, 2025 up to 10 am. The candidates are required to report
with all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of the same at
MMMUT, Gorakhpur.
The candidates are also required to bring a demand draft of Annual University Fee
[as per details given in following table]
S.No. Course University Fee (Rs.)
1. B.Tech. First Year 1,37,500/- for non-Hosteller
Please note that after seat allotment (if offered), the candidate has to immediately
deposit Annual University Fee in the form of demand draft. The demand draft
should be made in favour of MMMUT Gorakhpur payable at Gorakhpur (IFSC-
SBIN0002578) failing which the seat allotment shall be cancelled, and the seat
will be offered to the next available candidates as per his/her rank. If a candidate
will withdraw his/her candidature at later stage, then only caution money will be
refunded.
विशेष : कृपयास् पॉट राउंड में प्र विभाग करने िाले सभी अभ् यवथियों को विश्व विद्य ालय द्व ारा विवभन् न पाठ्यक्र मों हेिु
उपरोक्त िावलका में दवशिि फीस के ड्र ाफ् ट सवहि आना है क् यों वक स् पॉट काउंवसवलंग में सीट आिंवटि होने की दशा में
िुरंि फीस का ड्र ाफ्ट जमा करना अवनिायि है। निर्धारित फीस निसी भी अन्य मधध्यमों जैसे ऑिलधइि व ििद
इत्यधनद रू प मेंस् वीिधि िहीं िी जधएगी । फीस का ड्र ाफ् ट जमा न कराने की दशा में सीट का आिंटन रद्द कर अगली
मेररट रैंक के फीस ड्र ाफ् ट के साथ उपवस् थि अभ् यथी को सीट आिंवटि कर दी जाएगी । इसवलए काउंवसवलंग में प्र विभाग
करने िाले सभी अभ्यवथियों से अपेक्षा है वक िे स् पॉट राउंड में फीस के ड्र ाफ् ट जोवक MMMUT Gorakhpur
payable at Gorakhpur (IFSC-SBIN0002578) के नाम से बना हो, के साथ ही काउंवसवलंग में प्र
विभाग करें।
Chairman, Admission Cell-2025
